compiler.validation: Phase VII generic descriptor admission, typed provider calls, and canonical Actions/Debug canaries

evidence.summary: The descriptor-selected mncs-test provider was admitted and called through provider_call in a consumer that imports only the shared protocol.
A second provider with different provider/interface/revision/inventory identities was admitted through the same generic boundary.

evidence.ref: mncs run-app provider-admission-probe with tampered interface descriptor
evidence.summary: Admission refused a descriptor/artifact interface mismatch before the consumer call.
Actions selected the descriptor, admitted mncs-test, called it natively, and published canonical receipt/evidence/proof artifacts.
Actions published a provider-owned FAIL result, FAIL receipt, EvidenceManifest, and SelectedFamilyProof.
Debug directly interpreted the five canonical Actions/provider artifacts, recomputed provider identities, and selected bounded Trace escalation.

reproduction.instructions: Run the mncs-test provider admission probe and failure-provider probe; run the native Actions application with the admitted descriptor; feed its canonical artifacts to mncs-debug.

summary: Generic authoritative provider admission now establishes descriptor, source, interface, provider, revision, and inventory identities before a same-session typed call. Actions has no concrete mncs-test provider import; two different provider descriptors were admitted through the same runtime boundary, and the second provider produced the real FAIL artifact consumed by native Debug.

workaround.description: The static provider import and provider-specific runtime admission workaround are removed from the normal Actions native path.
